name: @gond/box
description: The Gond box: the computer every bot works on, with terminals and a desktop for you.

scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); for (const file of fs.readdirSync('.').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.mjs'))) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
